briefs.headline: Four days of leave buy ten days off over Christmas and New Year — the leave maths is this weekend’s planning post. MINI and OSIM post before lunch, no shoot.
Tampines is Singapore’s biggest town, 296,060 residents — SingStat’s count is this week’s heartland-pride post. IKEA and Hougang Mall post before lunch, no shoot.
“Are you guys happy?” A first-jobber’s Reddit question drew a thread that settled on “content, not happy”. OSIM and Dunkin’ post before lunch, no shoot.
A chill job or a learning job? A 16-year-old’s post-O-level job plan, and her dad’s reply, split r/SGexams. UOB and Hougang Mall post before lunch, no shoot.
Who pays for the farewell dinner? A junior’s post on splitting the boss’s bill split the comments. Dunkin’ posts before lunch, no shoot.
PSI 68–75 at 8am — the first Moderate morning since Friday, after 103–138 on Sunday. IKEA and HYROX post one line before lunch, no shoot, no health claims.
“Almost 20 hours in my room” — a Redditor’s sleep-and-scroll weekend drew a wave of “same” on a second hazy Sunday. IKEA and OSIM post for the homebodies before noon, no shoot.
The air turned Unhealthy for the weekend — 24-hour PSI 116–144 at 8am, up from 67–90 a day earlier. IKEA, the three malls and HYROX post one stay-in card before 11am, no shoot.
A Singaporean dad lost 21kg to keep up with his daughters — and placed fifth in his first bodybuilding show, with another on Saturday. HYROX, AUFF, OSIM and AIA post before the weekend, no shoot.
Hijacked WhatsApp accounts are asking parents for money in their children’s names — 128 cases and S$249,000 since September. UOB posts one call-first card today, no shoot.
Singapore is first in the world for what its pay buys, and eighth once the hours are counted — a 43.1-hour week against Norway’s 37.5. OSIM and Dunkin’ post into it before lunch, no shoot.

Singapore is grading its bosses on the haze — Redditors are trading office arrangements, from free N95s at reception to “five days WFO, thank you boss”, as NEA warns the smoke may return tonight. Dunkin’, IKEA and OSIM post before lunch, no shoot.
Singapore’s runners have moved into the malls — a 7am lap of an empty Marina Square is going round Instagram, with a weekly Saturday repeat. HYROX, AUFF and OSIM post before Saturday, no shoot.
iPhone Duo pre-orders were fully reserved at Singtel by 5.30am — a day after opening. Samsung’s no-names reply and Maersk Air’s LinkedIn post go out before shops open on 23 Oct.

BIGBANG plays the National Stadium tonight under a haze plan — plastic bottles only, and the show stops only above PSI 300 (central was 189 at 8am). One fan-utility post before the afternoon, no shoot.
The skyline went missing — central Singapore’s 24-hour PSI was 226 at 8am, and the feeds are full of before-and-after photos. One N95-collection card before lunch, no shoot.
“Now got butter police?” — a kaya-toast scolding has Singapore defending how strangers eat breakfast, the one light story on a Very Unhealthy morning. One how-I-eat-it post before lunch, no shoot.
“Same guy, same face, different background” — a Redditor’s Europe-photo dating experiment is the light story in a heavy week. One before-and-after post before lunch, no shoot.
The haze has stopped Singapore’s runners — central Singapore’s 24-hour PSI was 168 at 8am, up from 146 yesterday, and run clubs keep cancelling. One indoor-training post before lunch, no shoot.

The morning after the race, still under haze — #f1 and #singaporegp are No. 1 and No. 2 on TikTok SG, central Singapore’s 24-hour PSI was 146 at 8am, and HPB has cancelled today’s outdoor sessions. One race-recap post before noon, indoors, no shoot.
Race night, with the air a little kinder — central Singapore’s 24-hour PSI was 152 at 8am, down from 175 yesterday, and lights out is 8pm. One race-night post before 6pm, indoors-first, no shoot.
World Mental Health Day lands in the season’s worst air — central Singapore’s 24-hour PSI was 175 at 8am, and the Sprint starts at 5pm. One check-in post before lunch, indoors, no shoot.
F1 opens under unhealthy air — central Singapore’s 24-hour PSI was 166 at 8am, with first practice at 4.30pm. Every race post today goes out indoors-first, before lunch, no shoot.
Haze is forecast unhealthy right into race weekend — the west hit 161 at 6am. Re-read every F1 post for outdoor cheer, then one indoor-plans post before lunch, no shoot.
A Van Gogh void deck in MacPherson is going round again — and the comments want one under every block. One heartland-pride post before lunch, no shoot.
F1 race week starts today — buses skip Esplanade Bridge from this morning and Padang roads close at midnight. One “how to get round it” post before the evening commute, no shoot.
Nine Asian Games silvers, a national record — and the comments are only counting golds. One post for the silver side before lunch, no shoot.
Six in ten Singaporeans skip strength training — the national health surveys say 87.3% move enough but only 37.6% lift. One fitness post before lunch, no shoot.
The Weeknd plays his second National Stadium night tonight — night one topped SG’s Google entertainment searches. One morning-after post ready for Sunday, no shoot.
Two in three SG workers feel “always-on” — JobStreet’s study landed yesterday, and today is a Friday. One clock-out post before 6pm, no shoot.
PSLE is over — the last written papers sat yesterday and Children's Day is tomorrow. One post for P6 families before lunch, no shoot.
Haze is back: 24-hour PSI is Unhealthy in four of five regions (119 in the west and central at 7am). Publish one indoor-plan post before lunch, caring tone, no shoot.

Loh Kean Yew plays Thailand's Kunlavut Vitidsarn for the Asian Games badminton gold at 8.30am SGT today, the first Singaporean in an Asian Games badminton final. Pre-write a gold and a silver post; publish the moment it ends. No shoot, zero risk.

Loh Kean Yew plays his Asian Games badminton semi-final today, a day after upsetting world No. 1 Jonatan Christie to clinch Singapore's first-ever individual Asian Games badminton medal. A same-day watch-and-cheer post, zero risk, no shoot needed.

Shanti Pereira races the Asian Games 200m final in Nagoya today, defending the title she won at Hangzhou 2023 — a day after her 100m silver. A same-day watch-and-cheer post, zero risk, no shoot needed.

Shanti Pereira's 100m silver at the Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya — 11.21s, 0.01s off her own national record, and her third individual Asian Games athletics medal. A same-day congratulations post, zero risk, no shoot needed.

Mid-Autumn Festival is here — mooncake and lantern content peaks today. Same night, Halloween Horror Nights 14 opens at USS and Singapore's FIFA ASEAN Cup opener vs Indonesia kicks off 1pm in Jakarta.
A highly venomous black spitting cobra spotted near Serangoon Gardens has outrun NParks twice. No shoot, no risk — the searches themselves are the joke.

A Sengkang void-deck "butcher" video is going properly viral. SFA has confirmed to Mothership it's investigating a group filmed chopping and reselling wholesale meat at Block 107 Rivervale Walk — a uniquely Singaporean scene, zero shoot required.
Tiffany Teo wins Singapore's first gold of the 2026 Asian Games, beating Uzbekistan's Khilola Sobirova in overtime in the women's 60kg MMA final. A same-day congratulations post, zero risk.

Singapore Tennis Open opens today at The Kallang — Southeast Asia's only WTA 500, with Alexandra Eala, fresh off her first WTA singles title, drawing a first-round bye as No. 3 seed. Tickets from S$8, one of the cleanest, lowest-risk content days of the week.

Yoga Inc's abrupt closure — the studio texted over 30 instructors on Friday night that it can't pay September wages, and members with unused class packages have had no response since. A fitness brand can credibly say "bring your receipt, first class is on us" while the story is still raw.

Chinatown's Mid-Autumn opening ceremony runs from 6pm tonight at Kreta Ayer Square — a community lantern procession, mooncake-and-tea appreciation and lantern riddles in all four official languages, the first year without the giant lanterns on Eu Tong Sen Street and New Bridge Road.

iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max hit Singapore stores this morning. Queues at Orchard Road, Jewel and Marina Bay Sands are the day's cleanest, lowest-risk content — one photo, timestamped, before the crowds thin out by lunch.

The act-today post is the moving-fee viral story. A woman quoted $228 to move house was hit with a $1,280 "long pushing distance" surcharge mid-move, for a $1,706 total — a same-day window for any brand that can credibly say its quote is the bill.

The Maxwell-reopens-tomorrow post. It's the last day of Maxwell Food Centre's scheduled cleaning closure, one of 28 hawker centres cycled through this week — the alternative-stalls window is open today only.

The haze-is-back post. NEA's 7am reading put every region of Singapore in the unhealthy PSI band for the first time this spell — central highest at 153 — with the dry spell set to persist. Indoor-comfort content is live now, not filler.
The back-to-Term-4 post. School resumes this morning after the nine-day break, the one clean back-to-routine Monday of the month — post it before lunchtime, not after.

The last-day-of-holidays post. The nine-day school holidays end tonight and Term 4 starts tomorrow — the closing window for any "one final thing before Monday" post, alongside a record S$133,009 Cat A COE and the final Toa Payoh #RevUpSG F1 watch party.

The pre-order-night post. iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max pre-orders open at 8pm tonight, still capped at two units per customer — trade-in and accessory creative needs to be live before the window opens, not after.

The pre-order-eve prep post. iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max pre-orders open at 8pm tomorrow (Sat 12 Sep), capped at two units per customer — trade-in and telco creative needs to be ready before the window opens, not after.

The keynote-morning reaction post. Apple's "Surprise and Shine" keynote streamed at 1am SGT, revealing the iPhone 18 Pro (from S$1,899) and its first foldable, the iPhone Duo (from S$3,099) — the sticker-shock conversation is happening in Singapore right now, hours old, not next week.

The 9.9 peak day post. Shopee and Lazada's 9.9 Super Shopping Day peaks today, the same day $400–$600 in Enhanced Cost-of-Living Special Payments starts landing in PayNow-linked accounts for over 2.4 million citizens. The payout-meets-sale window is live now, not next week.

The hot, hazy dry-spell post. NEA is tracking Singapore's 24-hour PSI back up into the low-unhealthy range today as the dry spell over the region drags on, with daytime highs also pushing toward 34–35°C through the rest of the week. The indoor-comfort and hydration content window is live now, not a slow-news filler.

The Krakatau disruption post. Anak Krakatau's eruption has shut eight Indonesian airports and stranded an estimated 170,000 passengers since Sunday; Singapore Airlines has cancelled multiple SIN–Jakarta flights with more disruption likely today.
The Community Shield kickoff post. The 2026/27 season opens tonight at Jalan Besar, 7.30pm — one clean same-day watch-party window for F&B and beverage brands.

The haze × holiday-starts-today post. Three regions crossed into unhealthy air overnight and the nine-day school break begins this morning — the indoor-alternative content window is live now, not next week.
The Teachers' Day post. Term 3 ends today, no school, and the nine-day break follows — the biggest organic gratitude-and-nostalgia UGC day of the month, live now.

The haze × school-holiday post. PSI has drifted into unhealthy-for-sensitive-groups territory today, two days before nine days off begin. Publish before any formal advisory lands — after that it reads as opportunism.
The closures post. Emotion is live now, one image and one line, zero risk.
